payload.description: Finance teams racing to adopt AI are focused on tools and agents — but the real bottleneck is documentation. This guide, inspired by Nathan Mapp, CPA, explains why process documentation is the single most important investment you can make for AI readiness, and how internal audit teams are uniquely positioned to lead the charge.
payload.name: Why Documentation is the #1 Factor for AI Implementation Success
payload.title: Why Documentation is the #1 Factor for AI Implementation Success
